errors.evidence: The description incorrectly expands the acronym БДС to 'брутния домашен продукт' (Gross Domestic Product). The figure caption and common economic context indicate it stands for 'брутна добавена стойност' (Gross Value Added).
The description of the first line fails to mention that it is a dashed line, which is a visual feature that distinguishes it from the second, solid line.

errors.text_span: значителен спад между 2008 и 2009 г. (от 15819.9 до 18537.8 лева)
errors.evidence: The description claims a drop for the blue line from 15819.9 to 18537.8 between 2008 and 2009. The actual values for the blue line are 18631.4 (2008) and 18329.6 (2009). The cited values are incorrect, mixing data from different years and series, and they represent an increase, contradicting the claim of a 'спад' (drop).

The description incorrectly states that the second (orange) line has a lower starting value than the first (blue) line. The chart clearly shows the orange line starting at a higher value (14300.4) than the blue line (7151.9).
